note: Ordered label rules for amount_due; the first label found (in rule order) wins. Historical totals ('totale versato', 'già corrisposto') are deliberately not labels. expects_amount: doc types whose missing amount is RECUPERARE (not silently null). v2.1: A-003 reads the label by its structure (amount noun + up to three qualifiers + ':' or 'di') and commits only when the document states ONE monetary amount ('unique_amount'): with two or more, which one is due is a guess -> no match. when.after_not: the rule does not apply when the rest of the sentence after the figure matches. v2.2: two readers. 'when.reader' says who applies a rule: 'labels' (default; arm A: A-001..A-003), 'grammar' (arm B's label grammar, ported as A-004) or 'both' (A-001, the same rule in both arms). Each reader reads by itself and the pair of readings is looked up in 'agreement' (ordered, first match wins, abstention at the top). when.label_not: the rule does not apply when the matched label itself matches.

rules.rationale: for an instalment plan the actionable figure is the instalment

rules.rationale: generalised label: a singular amount noun (importo, somma, totale), up to three qualifiers that all mean 'what is owed' (complessivo, dovuto, a debito, da pagare, capitale, richiesto, intimato...), then ':' or 'di' and the figure; accepted only if no other monetary amount appears in the document. Any other qualifier (minimo, versato, residuo, rateizzato...) is not read: no match v2.1 safety: 'after_not' looks at the rest of the sentence after the figure - wording that says the sum was paid, is to be refunded or is a credit ('già corrisposto', 'da rimborsare a Voi', 'a Vostro favore', 'non dovuto') means the figure is not an amount due: not read. The uniqueness check also counts amounts written without decimals next to a currency word ('euro 200')

rules.rationale: v2.2, label grammar ported from arm B (its A-002; the pattern inside the word boundary is verbatim): head noun (importo | somma | totale) + any number of the qualifiers (complessivo, dovuto, residuo, a debito, da pagare, da versare, richiesto, ingiunto, precettato) + optional 'di' / 'pari a'; 'per complessivi' kept as is. The currency word is optional and read by the amount pattern. It reads what A-002/A-003 do not: the connector 'pari a', a label with no connector at all ('Totale da versare € 310,00'), 'precettato', more than three qualifiers. In arm B it had no condition. Here it is a second reader: alone (A-X04) it commits only under arm A's nets for a generalised label - one monetary amount in the document (unique_amount), nothing in the rest of the sentence that says the figure is not due (after_not: the pattern of A-002/A-003 plus three phrases for this reader only - 'bonificato', 'nota di credito', 'a titolo di sconto / abbuono'), a word boundary before the noun ('sottototale') - and label_not: 'residuo' is read only next to a qualifier that says the residue is owed ('importo residuo dovuto'); a bare 'importo residuo' may be what is left for a later notice (arm A's A-003-neg-residual). Whether a residue is the amount due is [TO CONFIRM with counsel]. Without the nets it is still used, to see whether it contradicts the labels reader (A-X01).
